entry_points.text: Firmware helper declares probe callback tied to compatibility string; compat macros generate per-arity entries with sanitized-argument handling.
Dispatch enqueues work when queue present else invokes inline; offset helper derives pointer from stored displacement, and unsafe-alias wrapper hides aliasing from analysis.

exports.text: Clock init builders create named setups with ops table and flags, varying parent linkage by name, hardware handle, firmware name or arrays, plus parentless and single-parent forms; fixed-factor builders reuse shared ops with caller factors.

Firmware registration and parent lookup are neutral shims reporting success while indexed lookup reports missing entry; hardware helpers convert between opaque handle and anchor and test parent rate propagation.
Consumer clocks acquire empty handles, report unsupported for notifier paths, map missing optional firmware entries to empty, and report false for enabled query.

Closure wake orders prior list updates before delegating to internal wake; call initializes with optional parent then schedules first function via no-barrier path; container helper recovers outer object from work.
Default tag captures build module identity with function file line and cleared flags; without section support module helpers report no section needed and no-op lifecycle success.
Process event connectors such as fork and exit are empty inline no-ops in this configuration.
Compat mask transfer copies between native and compat user masks; unsafe put copies under caller fault handling; alt-stack saver stores address flags size; pointer helper widens 32-bit address.
Sanitizer opt-outs exclude instrumentation with active and empty forms; diagnostic helpers build pragmas by severity with version handling; branch hint has instrumented and plain builds.
Barriers pin pointers and block motion; relocation hiding obscures address arithmetic; unique-id builds distinct names; array checks classify suitable arguments.

hazards.text: Preparation and bulk preparation may sleep and must avoid non-sleepable context.
Enqueue failure traps fatally, debug builds trap on unexpected remaining counts and reference misuse, and inline dispatch runs in caller context so blocking work stalls invoker.
Unsafe compat user helpers require active user-access region and caller failure label; use outside region mishandles faults and yields endian-incorrect signal state.
Generic relocation hiding uses visible arithmetic while GCC form conceals addition; entry helper emits persistent reference keeping symbol reachable.
Sanitizer revision is five in Clang and four in one GCC variant, with thread marker expanding by toolchain.
Compat ABI disables 64-bit time, derives bits per compat long from width, and selects 64-bit flock packing per architecture.

invariants.text: Each provider offers conversion from embedded hardware anchor back to enclosing fractional, multiplier or composite object, preserving identity between outer descriptor and inner anchor.
Combined helpers prepare before activation and teardown reverses order, and range clearing expands to full span.
Acquire marks possible blocking and raises count, init establishes running count one with optional parent, and debug create plus instruction tracking are no-ops unless enabled.

Event wait tests predicate before sleeping, otherwise waits on stack closure then wakes peers and syncs; timeout variant uses deadline from now plus interval with tick on success and zero on expiry; remaining query masks counter.
Compat mode query reports task state or constant false; jiffies scale by compat frequency, identity uses 32-bit uid type, and 32-bit siginfo copy aliases internal helper.
Each generic header uses an include-once guard preventing repeated inclusion.
Reference handling relies on external atomic primitives, dispatch relies on external workqueue queue, and wake ordering relies on external memory barrier owned outside this dossier.

locks.text: Fractional divider and multiplier hold a pointer to external protection rather than embedding it, requiring callers to provide shared exclusion covering register updates.
Closures lack internal spin protection; waiting uses lockless chaining with waker barrier making prior updates visible.
Static checking declares lock-capable types, required holdings, and data-to-lock binding, with scope suppression; all empty when disabled.

state_machines.text: Reference state reserves counter field with flag bits; continuations install next function plus queue then drop running reference or requeue, with distinct plain termination form.
Clock use follows prepare-then-activate with teardown reversing order, notification phase bracketing rate transitions.

structs.text: Fractional divider pairs anchor with register, two field placements, option byte, optional approximation callback and shared lock; multiplier pairs anchor with register, one placement, option byte and lock; composite aggregates local ops plus separate anchors and ops for select rate gate.
Notification state links clock with sleepable chain and list linkage, transition record carries old and new rates, and bulk record pairs identifier with handle.
Closure centers on waitlist head for lockless chaining and object with two views sharing storage for queue and work, plus parent linkage, atomic reference and debug tag.
Bounded unsigned ranges pair base plus size in 32 and 64-bit widths, with defined unbounded sentinel at zero with maximal size.

Code tag records flag bits line and module function file names with eight-byte alignment; type descriptor holds section identity tag size and callbacks, iterator holds type module cursor plus identity and sequence state, with one low flag bit for inaccurate tags.

Compat layouts include address-plus-length vector, fixed signal word array, arch-varying signal actions with handler flags restorer mask, and large signal info with number error code plus varied payloads.
Further compat layouts cover file locks, resource limits, network interface requests and robust futex list heads.

Per-site branch records carry source identity with outcome counts in dedicated sections; compiler supplies 4-byte byte-swap, version encoding weighting major by 10000 and minor by 100, and typeof support flag.

Flag encodings include fractional zero-based, multiplier zero-bypass, and pre-change notification bits; closure guard and remaining masks isolate transitions and counter, with distinct dead debug tag.
